references.text: Jesus instructs one who has been healed of leprosy not to tell anyone, but to show himself to the priest and offer what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.
After healing two blind men, Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about this.
After healing a man who was deaf and had difficulty speaking, Jesus ordered the people not to tell anyone, but the more he commanded them, the more they spread the news.
After cleansing a leper, Jesus told him not to tell anyone, but to go and show himself to the priest and offer for his cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.
